The '''Karthakk Sector Force''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]], assigned to the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Like most of the other Sector Forces, it was created from a local resistance movement: the [[Karthakk resistance]]. This Sector Force was known to be able to support respectable fleets and armies from its own resources.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
